title: RateLoadRequest
description: The input of rate.load: one sheet of exchange rates for the call's own company, dsor://org_456/tenant/org_456, from the source its money policy names, published at a time in UTC, with how much of each currency one unit of its base buys, as the source wrote it (step 26's README, decisions L2, D3, D5, D8, and D9). This tutorial's own schema: the specification names no operation that loads rates. The company's pattern is the specification's resourceUri, with this tutorial's /tenant/ beside it, as in ProposalExpireDueRequest. The other patterns are this tutorial's own. A rate is a decimal above zero, and a time ends with Z.
